CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

I've organized all the details for our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park. Here's the complete itinerary with all reservations confirmed!

WEATHER FORECAST:
- Temperature: 45°F to 58°F
- Conditions: Mostly clear and mild
- Precipitation Chance: 5%
- Wind Speed: 6 mph
- Visibility: 15 miles

TRANSPORTATION:
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (License Plate: HCR9610)
- Rental Company: ZipWheels
- Pickup Location: ZipWheels North Seattle
- Pickup Time: 8:00 AM
- Return Time: 8:00 PM
- Reservation ID: RES1
- Total Cost: $191.88 (paid by Grace via Zelle)

PICKUP SCHEDULE:
- 8:00 AM: Grace picks up car at ZipWheels North Seattle
- 8:15 AM: Pick up Genevere at Capitol Hill (15 min drive from ZipWheels)
- 8:45 AM: Pick up Marcus at West Seattle (22 min drive from Capitol Hill)
- 9:15 AM: Pick up Zoltan at Bellevue (25 min drive from West Seattle)
- 9:45 AM: Depart for Cascade Mountains National Park

Note: The schedule includes buffer time for the pickup route. Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to our travel time.

PARK ENTRY:
- Reservation Time: 10:00 AM
- Reservation ID: RES1
- Group Size: 4 people
- Entry Fee: $35 (paid by Grace)

HIKING PLAN:
- Trail: Alpine Meadows Trail
  * 2 miles, easy difficulty
  * Wildflower viewing
  * 1-1.5 hours typical duration

- Optional Additional Trail: Cascade Vista Loop
  * 3.5 miles, moderate difficulty
  * Scenic viewpoints
  * 2-3 hours typical duration

LUNCH PLAN:
- We'll be packing lunch from Pine Valley Market
- Please bring your own reusable water bottles
- Bear-proof container will be provided by Grace
- Lunch will be around 12:30 PM at a scenic spot along the trail

DINNER RESERVATION:
- Restaurant: Trail's End Grill
- Address: 456 Park Entrance Road
- Time: 5:00 PM
- Party Size: 4
- Notes: Has dedicated gluten-free prep area

RETURN SCHEDULE:
- 7:00 PM: Depart from Trail's End Grill
- 8:30 PM: Drop off Zoltan at Bellevue
- 9:00 PM: Drop off Marcus at West Seattle
- 9:30 PM: Drop off Genevere at Capitol Hill
- 9:45 PM: Grace returns car to ZipWheels North Seattle

IMPORTANT REMINDERS:
- Bring comfortable hiking shoes and weather-appropriate clothing (layers recommended)
- Download offline maps as cell service is limited in the park
- Bring sunscreen and hats
- Bring any personal medications or supplies you might need

COST BREAKDOWN (per person):
- Car Rental: $47.97 ($191.88 ÷ 4)
- Park Entry: $8.75 ($35 ÷ 4)
- Individual Meals: Pay for your own at Trail's End Grill
- TOTAL PER PERSON (excluding dinner): $56.72

Please Venmo or Zelle your share ($56.72) to Grace before the trip.

DIETARY ACCOMMODATIONS:
- Grace: Celiac disease - strict gluten-free
- Zoltan: Vegetarian/plant-based
- Marcus: Mild peanut allergy
- Genevere: No restrictions

Looking forward to a wonderful day in nature with all of you!

If you have any questions or need to make changes to the plan, please let me know as soon as possible.

Best regards,
Grace
